jit.title: Just-in-Time Access
jit.desc: Replace standing privilege with request-based, time-limited elevated access.
jit.subtitle: Grant elevated privileges only when needed, for a specific duration, and automatically revoke them when the window closes.
jit.feat1Desc: Keep user accounts unprivileged by default until authorized elevation is requested.
jit.feat2Desc: Tie access requests to ServiceNow, Jira, or internal ITSM change orders for accountability.
jit.feat3Desc: Privileges expire automatically when the approved duration ends — no manual cleanup required.
jit.feat4Desc: Require strong MFA confirmation at the exact moment privileged elevation is requested.
jit.feat5Desc: Issue short-lived certificates or dynamic credentials that are invalid after use.
jit.feat6Desc: Route approvals based on requested resource sensitivity, user role, and session risk indicators.
